name: oem-msi
description: MSI laptop OEM layer. Deliberately KEEPS MSI Center core (MSI_Center_Service, MSI Foundation Service, Micro Star SCM) because on gaming laptops those control fan curves, Cooler Boost and the battery charge limit. Removing them leaves you on firmware defaults.

actions.description: Nahimic audio enhancement layer. Realtek audio works without it. NOTE: reinstalling the Realtek audio driver brings this back.
Nahimic service - installs into C:\Windows\System32, so path-based OEM filters miss it
MSI event reporting service. Telemetry only - no effect on fan or performance control.
Mystic Light RGB keeper. Disabling means no keyboard RGB control.
Mystic Light task host. WARNING: MSI Center re-arms this at every boot. The durable fix is turning Mystic Light off inside MSI Center's own UI.
Branded 'Intel Rapid Storage Technology Application'. The management UI only - the RST driver is separate and unaffected.
Intel Thunderbolt Share (PC-to-PC file/screen sharing). Does NOT affect Thunderbolt ports, docks, displays or eGPUs - those run off the controller driver.
